title: duplicate visits collapse at render
setup: one browser stream; six browser.visit events to one URL between 13:58:00 and 13:58:25 (within 30 seconds), transition typed then reload, visit_count 12; a seventh visit to another URL after.
expected: One packed line for the run: `×6`, first–last times (13:58–13:58 or the exact span), the transition and visit_count on the head, never dwell_ms. All 6 events remain in the input (render-time only, nothing deleted). The seventh visit is its own line.

wrong.label: six-lines
wrong.assert_absent: six separate packed lines for the same URL within 30 s

wrong.label: rows-deleted
wrong.assert_absent: fewer than 6 events surviving the collapse (the log must keep every visit)

source.section: GoldenEvals V6P1 §5.3 SRC-10 · duplicate visits collapse at render
